# Checked ordinary Greedy trajectory projection

`cases.bin` projects the fixed ordinary C capture without running a codec. All
integers are little-endian. Counts are unsigned u32 unless stated otherwise;
a blob is a u32 byte length followed by that many bytes. Names use u16 lengths.
The file begins `ZGRFR01\0`, case count138 and positive-block count395, followed
by length-prefixed case records. `provenance.json` pins source and generator
identities. Complete frame bytes are copied from the immutable C observation
pack; none are generated by the Rust encoder.

Each case contains name; eight bytes W/H/C/S/M/row/reserved0/reserved0; u32 target;
source blob and u64 FNV64; scheduled-frame blob and u64 FNV64; byte whole-present,
then optional whole-frame blob and u64 FNV64; schedule count and u32 lengths;
positive-block count and length-prefixed block records. Zero calls remain in
the schedule; their unchanged tables/state were verified in the original pack.

Each block contains four u32 values (call ordinal, source start, length, logical
prefix floor), byte kind, byte candidate-fresh, u16 zero; four repeat triples
(wire before/after, raw parser before/after); sampling before/after; both table
records; and a candidate when fresh. Each sampling record is four u32 values
(raw next-to-update, skipping, row hash log, salt entropy), u64 salt and eight
u32 cache values. Raw frontiers retain the C bias of two; copied caches preserve
evidence without prescribing Rust prefetch/cache machinery.

Each table record is byte log, byte element width (one or four), u16 zero,
delta count, ordered u32 triples (slot, old, new), and two u64 canonical FNV64
values. Both owners begin at zero, including row reserved positions/tag heads.
Zero new values are valid chain-link deltas. Deltas may update earlier prefix
positions; their count is bounded by owner length, not current block length.

A candidate contains raw parser repeat triple; wire repeat triple; u32 trailing
literal count; byte long-length kind plus three reserved zero bytes; u32 long
position; literal blob (including trailing literals); sequence count; and six
u32 values per sequence (literal length, match length, distance, offBase, raw
literal length, raw match-length base). Long marker zero implies position zero.
Full entropy/owner observations remain in the original NDJSON collection.

Run `scripts/pack_greedy_frame_trajectories.py --check` for independent immutable
source verification and byte-identical reconstruction. `--write` requires a
fresh destination and never overwrites prior expectations. Reference attribution
is retained in `../reference-greedy-frame-capture/NOTICE` and `LICENSE.zstd`.
